description: Points a domain's mail at FounderMail and authenticates what it sends. The receive group is the ownership challenge, the MX record, an SPF include merged into whatever SPF record the domain already has, and a DMARC policy; it is applied when the domain is claimed. The send group is the three Amazon SES Easy DKIM CNAMEs and the MX and SPF of the bounce subdomain SES uses as the custom MAIL FROM; it is applied once FounderMail has issued the DKIM keys, which happens after receiving is verified. A later application re-applies both groups.
variableDescription: %token%: the hex ownership token FounderMail issued for this claim, published as foundermail-verify=%token%. %dmarc%: the DMARC tags after v=DMARC1, for example p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com; when the domain already publishes a DMARC record FounderMail passes its tags back unchanged. %region%: the AWS region of the SES identity, which decides the bounce MX host. %dkim1%, %dkim2%, %dkim3%: the three Easy DKIM selectors SES issued for the domain.
